scope: apps/ + packages/ workspace projects including apps/zcode-cli subpackages and tools
note: No inherited module maps to the economic/trust/capability/financial layers; those are PaySwap-built. Inherited permission surfaces are platform application permission, never financial authorization.

modules.name: @zcode/rpc
modules.justification: Product-neutral VS Code-style IPC/RPC communication framework; explicitly KEEP-listed transport substrate.

modules.justification: HTTP/WebSocket services and remote connections; KEEP-listed session/event transport substrate for all clients.
modules.build_status: build PASS (tsup + build:remote); nested bare `pnpm` call requires corepack shim on PATH

modules.name: @zcode/web
modules.justification: Web client substrate (Vite); KEEP-critical platform package; the new PaySwap Web (P7-W1) is built on this substrate.
